brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, horizontal 16:9, target 1536x864 or larger, one single finished PNG.

Create a new illustration using two supplied reference images only as references:
Image 1 (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png): approved graphic STYLE reference only: charcoal black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory typography, confident hand-drawn ink and dry brush strokes. Do not copy this reference's person, pose, names, numbers, date, scores, or words.
Image 2 (mark-burton-official.png): IDENTITY reference only for real basketball player Mark Burton / マーク・バートン. This is an official profile photo. Interpret his actual likeness as hand-drawn ink illustration; do not paste any photo pixels or make a photograph. Do not reproduce the photo's uniform branding, letters, sponsor marks or numbers.

Subject: exactly one real player, Mark Burton, recognizable face based closely on Image 2: close-cropped short black hair, tapered sides, oval face and narrow jaw, medium-light brown skin interpreted in ivory/black ink, dark almond-shaped eyes, slim mustache, distinct pointed chin goatee, lean athletic build. Abstract ink tattoo patterns on upper arms, without tattoo lettering. Plain unbranded ivory basketball jersey and shorts with dark piping, black sleeve on his right elbow, no jersey number and no names.
Pose: a dynamic forward driving/gathering basketball move in the right 43% of the composition, torso leaning diagonally, both hands naturally gathering one orange basketball at waist height. Three-quarter body view, knees bent; his face remains large enough to recognize and mostly front-facing, focused expression. Five anatomically plausible fingers on each hand, natural elbow and wrist connections. All of face, hands and ball fully inside canvas, with space around them. Lower thighs may intentionally extend beyond the bottom edge. Make this a distinctive driving composition, not the upright shooting pose from Image 1.
Scene: abstract dark ground, two broad lime brush arcs behind the player suggesting speed. Sparse ink flecks. No opponent, crowd, scoreboard, hoop, team logo or league logo. Strong expressive hand-drawn linework, rough crosshatching, flat limited ink tones; distinctly illustrative, not photorealistic.

Editorial facts only: the supplied fixed article is dated 2026-11-20, B.ONE match results, all official match records pending as of 19:05 JST. Player was randomly selected from names appearing in article, and his depiction conveys NO claim about attendance, performance, points, win, or a specific event. This is a conceptual basketball image, not a recreation of that day's actual match.

Composition: clean text area on left 54%; player on right, never obscuring lettering. Premium bold Japanese Gothic typography, exceptionally legible and correctly spelled. Generous 4% edge safety margin. Header small, date medium, main title very large, pending-status message very prominent. Footer disclaimer clearly visible, not microscopic. No excessive panels, badges or extra decorative objects.

Text (verbatim), render ONLY these strings with exactly these spellings:
small top-left: "バスケまとめ"
date line: "2026.11.20｜B.ONE"
large headline in ivory: "試合結果"
medium line below headline: "公式記録の"
very large lime line: "確定待ち"
small but clear qualifier below: "19:05 JST時点"
bottom-left footer: "イラスト（AI生成）"
footer next to it: "イメージ"

No other text at all. No player name, no player statistics, no score, no performance claim, no uniform lettering, no logos, no watermarks. Maintain stylish calm negative space and enough contrast to read the pending status even as a small thumbnail.
